summary: MPCA-153 RETEST · Amend flow now works. The setAmendOpen ReferenceError from iteration_85 is fixed — amendOpen state was moved into RegistrationsInbox and RegistrationAmendModal is rendered from inside that same component. Verified end-to-end: (1) Amend Data button opens [data-testid=pr-amend-modal] with all scalar fields including [amend-field-mobile] and [amend-field-place_of_birth_city]; (2) editing mobile → Save Changes persists via POST /api/player-registrations/<id>/edit (backend audit event 'edited' appended, mobile updated to 9111111111 in DB); (3) modal closes after save; (4) Upload Doc on Behalf opens the SAME amend modal (no separate flow); (5) 'Return to Player' button is ABSENT and [pr-reject-btn] is present. Zero console errors during the flow. One MINOR UX side-effect noted below.

integration_issues.issue: After 'Save Changes' the parent PlayerRegistrations.load() sets `loading=true` which unmounts RegistrationsInbox entirely (renders <CricketLoader/> instead), so the previously selected row is lost. On re-render the review drawer shows the empty-state 'Select a registration on the left to review.' The updated mobile (9111111111) is only visible after the user manually re-clicks the row. The acceptance line 'review drawer should reflect the new mobile' is technically satisfied only after that extra click. Suggestion: in `load()` skip `setLoading(true)` for silent refreshes (add a `silent=true` param) OR after api.get in onSaved, don't call onChanged() and instead just update local `regs` state. Alternatively lift `selected` into the parent so it survives the loader remount.

action_items: MINOR: Prevent the review drawer from disappearing after Amend Save. Fix by making the post-save refresh 'silent' (don't toggle the full-page CricketLoader) so `selected` persists in RegistrationsInbox and the updated mobile shows inline without re-selecting the row.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerRegistrations.jsx load() blindly sets loading=true on every refresh — that unmounts child inboxes/detail panes on every save. Should pass a `silent` flag from mutating child actions to keep child state alive.

RegistrationAmendModal · edit endpoint returns 200 with no payload usage — save() ignores the response body; if the backend returns the updated registration, we could `setSelected(data)` directly from that call and skip the extra GET+load() round-trip.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of MPCA-153 acceptance criteria (1 minor UX regression on drawer refresh after save)

rca of the issue: iteration_85 RCA (setAmendOpen not defined) resolved. Fix approach: moved `const [amendOpen, setAmendOpen] = useState(false)` from parent PlayerRegistrations into child RegistrationsInbox (line 230) and rendered <RegistrationAmendModal .../> from within RegistrationsInbox' return tree (lines 311-326).
